CaseOps dependency artifact repair

glob 14.0.6-caseops.2 retains official glob 14.0.6 source, raw dist, types and APIs.
Only the default CommonJS/ESM minified bundles and maps are rebuilt with official
minimatch 11.0.8, @isaacs/nonrecursive-glob-match 1.1.0 and brace-expansion 5.0.13 inputs.
Glob's upstream main and Ignore braceExpandMax guards are retained unchanged.
Full bundled notices and immutable official input identities are retained.
No network access or npm lifecycle is used during rebuilding.
